_comment: A worked example for the AI App Builder page without a key (chat.mjs, watchExample( )). Written by hand and checked by tests/ai.spec.js against the pinned framework - not a recording of a model, and the page says so.
prompt: A to-do list where I can add, tick off and delete entries

steps.text:
A to-do list it is: an input with **Add**, the entries as a list with a checkbox each, and **Delete the done ones** to clear what is ticked.

The entries are a public table, `todos`, bound to the list - ticking a box changes `done` in the backend without a line of ABAP, and Add and Delete are two events in `main( )`.
Ran it - no errors, the app is running

It runs on the right. Type something and press **Add** (or Enter), tick an entry, then **Delete the done ones**.

When it fits, **Download for abapGit** puts the class into a repository you can pull into your system.

files.name: zcl_todo_list.clas.abap
